name: Hugging Face Inference Endpoints - H100 (GCP)
price_basis: per H100 GPU-hour, on-demand, GCP infrastructure. Fetched 2026-10-04. Billed by the minute. x1 instance with 80GB GPU memory.
notes: Hugging Face Inference Endpoints H100 at $10.0/GPU-hr on GCP. This is the most expensive published H100 rate found in this research. It is 63% above CoreWeave on-demand ($6.16), 50% above AWS p5 ($6.88), and 150% above Together AI's on-demand ($3.99). The managed-service premium is extreme here: GCP a3-edgegpu-8g = $9.46/8 = $1.18/GPU-hr, so HF charges 8.5x the underlying cloud rate. This is the clearest example of the managed-service premium in the GPU cloud market. HF bills by the minute.
